timelines.title: Linen
timelines.description: Breathable, lightweight, and naturally textured. Suitable for summer dresses, relaxed shirts, pants, and aprons.

timelines.title: Woven Cotton
timelines.description: Soft, breathable, and easy to sew, with little stretch. Suitable for tote bags, tops, pajama sets, and beginner practice pieces.

timelines.title: Rayon / Viscose
timelines.description: Soft, lightweight, and fluid, with a beautiful drape. Suitable for flowy dresses, breezy skirts, and lightweight blouses.

timelines.title: Polyester
timelines.description: Durable, wrinkle-resistant, and available in various textures and finishes. Suitable for jackets, structured skirts, linings, and everyday wear.

timelines.title: Knit / Jersey
timelines.description: Soft, stretchy, and comfortable, allowing easy movement. Suitable for T-shirts, loungewear, baby clothes, and leggings.

timelines.title: Denim / Canvas
timelines.description: Strong, durable, and generally more structured than lightweight fabrics. Suitable for jackets, jeans, tote bags, aprons, and vests.
